findings.reason: the plan must name where the composition strips a listing the input already carries (in `launch_plan`, before the named-lane branch) or the codex lane-change clause has no mechanism and the node's own gate will fail on a step the Change does not assign to a caller.
findings.text: §15's Change requires that "a listing the input already carries is replaced for such a lane and removed for any other", and its done-when requires that "a lane change of the two-figure clive run onto codex writes a lane-change prompt file that carries the brief and the restated fence and no figure listing". The Change attributes the rule to `_prompt_naming_images` in `reckon/_backends.py`, but that function is called from `launch_plan` only inside the named-lane guard (`bool(attached) and not dialect.images_on_argv and declares_image_input(backend)`, `reckon/_backends.py:2307`). A codex target declares image input and has `images_on_argv = True`, so the guard is false and the function never runs; the prompt that `change_lane` builds from the record's prompt file (`dispatch_sessions.py:1604`, which `§15`'s own fresh-dispatch change has just written with a figure listing) is passed through unchanged, so the lane-change file would carry the stale listing and the done-when clause would fail. No caller is named for the strip half, so a worker implementing exactly the named mechanism (`_prompt_naming_images` replaces) satisfies the replace clause and not the removal case it exists to cover

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — every file, symbol and test §15 names resolves at the base revision (verified above); the section carries no href.
rubric_items.done_when: pass — §15's done-when is measurable and declares a falsifiable negative control ("with the fresh dispatch writing the uncomposed prompt again, the fresh-dispatch naming test fails"), and every clause names a concrete artifact or reader to check.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — §15 writes no evidence to the plan's own paths; its done-when puts every log "under the run directory", which is the durable `~/.config/reckon/crew/runs/<run>` path, with each log headed by its revision and closed by `EXIT=`.
rubric_items.naming: pass — §15 introduces no plan label, ticket number or version tag into code; the section references are internal section numbers in plan prose, which is the plan's own vocabulary.
rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — the "removal" half of §15's listing rule is required by its Change and tested by its done-when, but the only mechanism the Change names for the rule (`_prompt_naming_images`) is reached only for a lane that *is* named its figures, so the mechanism as described cannot produce the codex-target clause.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §15 carries one deliverable (the prompt file the worker reads naming its figures); the comment correction and the reader unification ride the same two files in the same commit, which the author already weighed and accepted.
rubric_items.wiring: pass — §15's `depends-on` points at `a-review-can-see-the-figure#s14`, which exists and is done; the plan's `plan-informs` target resolves and its §6 carries the matching cross-plan depends-on.
